title: Aureline M5 supported-line audience packet variant
description: Canonical per-domain audience-packet record minted by the truth-feed and audience-packet lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Turns one canonical supported-line truth feed into an export-safe, audience-specific packet variant — support, procurement, or partner review — instead of a hand-assembled per-audience summary: it records the audience-packet scope the variant serves (a support bundle for support escalations, a procurement bundle for procurement checks, or a partner-review bundle for design-partner and partner review), binds the resolved supported-line identity, the bundled truth-feed reference the packet is projected from, the public-safe-versus-internal reference distinguishing what the variant exports from what it withholds, and the active packet note. Every packet variant excludes internal-only incident / security detail by default while still naming the current claim, evidence freshness, migration posture, and correction history for its audience, and links out to compatibility reports, known limits, migration guides, and release evidence rather than duplicating them. Downstream support, procurement, and partner surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's proof by hand. Public-safe and internal-only variants share one canonical record identity; raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
